### New patterns surfaced this cycle

- **NEW pattern: forward-scope row mid-cycle amendment.** CH-20 §D58.10 META is the **first time a chunk amends its own forward-scope row** at chunk-seal. - **NEW peer-tier directory introduction at `v0/conventions/`.** ADR-0058 §D58.8 META documents the new peer-tier shape (sibling of `v0/concepts/`, NOT child of `m<N>/architecture/`). Future Bucket-C-style ratification chunks may add per-area convention docs incrementally. **Pattern shape codified**: one thematic convention area = one file (no per-area subdirectories at this scale), no `README.md` index until the directory grows beyond ~10 files. CH-21+ planners can mirror.
- **5-file split at peer-tier as F1.B realization.** ADR-0058 §D58.9 META documents that the 5-file split (vs single consolidated file) was the user-locked granularity. The shape: one file per thematic convention area, ~150–375 words each, with cross-refs to ADR-0058 sub-decisions. Reusable for future ratification chunks where thematic areas don't share content meaningfully.
